t: 47 rannin 在仓野介的指使下 为主人之死报了仇 通过杀死了Kira Yoshinaka.
te: Forty-seven rōnin, under the command of Ōishi Kuranosuke, avenged the death of their master, by killing Kira Yoshinaka.
dz: 47 rannin 在仓野介的指使下 为主人之死报了仇 通过杀死了Kira Yoshinaka.
de: Forty-seven rōnin, under the command of Ōishi Kuranosuke, avenged the death of their master, by killing Kira Yoshinaka.

t: 在江户(今东京),四十七所罗宁中,除一所外,都犯下了"平克"(tritual suicide)…
te: In Edo (now Tokyo), all but one of the Forty-seven Ronin commit seppuku (ritual suicide) as recompense for avenging the…
dz: 在江户(今东京),四十七所罗宁中,除一所外,都犯下了"平克"(tritual suicide)来报答主人之死.
de: In Edo (now Tokyo), all but one of the Forty-seven Ronin commit seppuku (ritual suicide) as recompense for avenging their master's death.

t: 丹尼尔·德福因煽动诽谤罪入狱.
te: Daniel Defoe is imprisoned on charges of seditious libel.
dz: 丹尼尔·德福因煽动诽谤罪入狱.
de: Daniel Defoe is imprisoned on charges of seditious libel.

t: 沙皇彼得大帝建立了圣彼得堡市。
te: Tsar Peter the Great founds the city of Saint Petersburg.
dz: 沙皇彼得大帝建立了圣彼得堡市。
de: Tsar Peter the Great founds the city of Saint Petersburg.

t: 一支荷兰部队与一支法国部队之间的埃克伦战役.
te: The Battle of Ekeren between a Dutch force and a French force.
dz: 一支荷兰部队与一支法国部队之间的埃克伦战役.
de: The Battle of Ekeren between a Dutch force and a French force.

t: 在巴伐利亚鲁美尔战役中,蒂罗尔的农村人口将巴伐利亚亲王-选举人马克西米利安二世·伊曼纽尔从北蒂…
te: During the Bavarian Rummel the rural population of Tyrol drove the Bavarian Prince-Elector Maximilian II Emanuel out of…
dz: 在巴伐利亚鲁美尔战役中,蒂罗尔的农村人口将巴伐利亚亲王-选举人马克西米利安二世·伊曼纽尔从北蒂罗尔驱出,在庞特拉策桥取胜,从而阻止了与法国结盟的巴伐利亚军队在西班牙继承战争期间按计划在维也纳出征.
de: During the Bavarian Rummel the rural population of Tyrol drove the Bavarian Prince-Elector Maximilian II Emanuel out of North Tyrol with a victory at the Pontlatzer Bridge and thus prevented the Bavarian Army, which was allied with France, from marching as planned on Vienna during the War of the Spanish Succession.

t: Daniel Defoe在出版一本政治讽刺小册子后,因煽动性诽谤罪被关入一个民谣,但被花被打得…
te: Daniel Defoe is placed in a pillory for the crime of seditious libel after publishing a politically satirical pamphlet,…
dz: Daniel Defoe在出版一本政治讽刺小册子后,因煽动性诽谤罪被关入一个民谣,但被花被打得粉碎.
de: Daniel Defoe is placed in a pillory for the crime of seditious libel after publishing a politically satirical pamphlet, but is pelted with flowers.

t: 一场日本起义迫使奥斯曼苏丹穆斯塔法二世宣誓.
te: A janissary revolt forces the deposition of Ottoman sultan Mustafa II.
dz: 一场日本起义迫使奥斯曼苏丹穆斯塔法二世宣誓.
de: A janissary revolt forces the deposition of Ottoman sultan Mustafa II.

t: 奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆斯塔法二世被废黜.
te: Sultan Mustafa II of the Ottoman Empire is dethroned.
dz: 埃迪尔内事件:奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆斯塔法二世被废黜.
de: Edirne event: Sultan Mustafa II of the Ottoman Empire is dethroned.

t: 1703年的大风暴,大不列颠南部记录到的有史以来最伟大的风暴,使登陆. 风波暴发至120 mp…
te: The Great Storm of 1703, the greatest windstorm ever recorded in the southern part of Great Britain, makes landfall. Wi…
dz: 1703年的大风暴,大不列颠南部记录到的有史以来最伟大的风暴,使登陆. 风波暴发至120 mph,有9000人死亡.
de: The Great Storm of 1703, the greatest windstorm ever recorded in the southern part of Great Britain, makes landfall. Winds gust up to 120 mph, and 9,000 people die.

t: 葡萄牙和英国签署了 Methuen 条约，允许葡萄牙以优惠的贸易条件向英国出口葡萄酒。
te: Portugal and England sign the Methuen Treaty which allows Portugal to export wines to England on favorable trade terms.
dz: 葡萄牙和英国签署了 Methuen 条约，允许葡萄牙以优惠的贸易条件向英国出口葡萄酒。
de: Portugal and England sign the Methuen Treaty which allows Portugal to export wines to England on favorable trade terms.
